simple.meaning: אֲרָן (ʼĂrân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Aran , an Edomite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲרָן (H765) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 36:28, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲרָן (H765) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲרָן (H765) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲרָן (ʼĂrân) / H765 is traced through Genesis 36:28, 1 Chronicles 1:42 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
